# DropSpace v0.3.0-beta.32

<!-- update-summary: Harden island window lifetimes and async actions, update the Windows runtime, and improve redacted crash diagnostics. -->

## Changes

- Upgrade Windows App SDK to 2.5.1 and refresh the locked dependency graph.
- Retire island surfaces before native cleanup, guard closed/disposed windows, and avoid using retired surfaces while monitors are being rebuilt.
- Recheck window lifetime after asynchronous settings, clipboard, compact-mode and quick-action work. Late completions no longer open dialogs against an already closed island.
- Include HRESULT and redacted exception stack details in error diagnostics to make subsequent crash reports more actionable.
- Add regression coverage for native window lifetime handling and exception-log credential redaction.

## Compatibility and limits

Beta 31 is the immediate upgrade baseline. App identity, data directories and Stable/Beta update channels remain unchanged.

The reported UIInput.dll crash has not been conclusively reproduced or attributed to a single root cause. This release fixes concrete lifecycle hazards and updates the Windows runtime; it does not claim to eliminate every crash.

Publication requires the exact release commit's Windows tests, WinUI build, installer and portable lifecycle checks, packaging and release validation. Automated coverage does not replace physical mixed-DPI and real-player testing.
